questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and make a grammatically correct sentence.**

The recent lawsuit _____ put the firm in a tight spot.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'has'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In the given blank,** *we need a singular verb because the subject of the sentence is singular in number i.e. 'lawsuit' also after the blank the irregular form of the verb has been written and this verb should be in the third form of the verb so we need a helping which is going to be 'has'*

**So the correct sentence is-** *The recent lawsuit **has** put the firm in a tight spot.*

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No improvement.**

Garima **__live at__ **the 25th floor.
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 'lives on'.**

One cannot 'live in' a floor, one can only 'live on' a floor - 'live in' a flat or bungalow is correct.

Thus, options 1 and 2 are incorrect. Also, 'Garima' is a singular subject. So, *lives *should be used as the sentence is in the simple present tense.

__Correct sentence:__ *Garima __lives on__ the 25th floor.*

questions.question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

Rakesh was studied when his friends called him.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is **'studied when'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

In this part of the sentence, the usage of **'studied when'** is incorrect Instead, use '**studying when**' 

 
• The sentence is in the present continuous tense - 'studied' refers to the past tense and thus is the segment of the sentence which has a grammatical error. It should be replaced with 'studying'.

So the correct sentence is- *Rakesh **was studying** when his friends called him.*

questions.question: A is more efficient than B and they together can complete a work in 24 days. Had A done 50% of the work and then B, the remaining work, then the work would have been done in 50 days. B alone will complete 40% of the same work in:
questions.solution:
Let work done per unit day by A = a unit

And, work done per unit day by B = b unit

Now, total work = (a + b) × 24 units

According to question,

{12(a + b)/a} = {12(a + b)/b} = 50

As, we have 2 variables and 1 equation, we can assume some value for one variable

Lets, take a = 1

{12(1 + b)/1} = {12(1 + b)/b} = 50

⇒ 12 + 12b = 12/b + 12 = 50

⇒ 12b +12/b = 26

⇒ 6b + (6/b) = 13

⇒ 6b² + 6 = 13b

⇒ 6b² – 13b + 6 = 0

⇒ 6b² – 9b – 4b + 6 = 0

⇒ 3b(2b – 3) – 2(2b – 3) = 0

⇒ (3b - 2)(2b - 3) = 0

⇒ b = 2/3 or 3/2

As, a > b, b = 2/3

Now, total work = (1 + 2/3) × 24 = 40 units

40% of total work = 40 × 40% = 16 units

Hence, time taken by B = 16/(2/3) = 24 day

questions.question: The speed of a train is 3 times that of a car and 1.5 times of a steamer. A person travelled x km by steamer, 3.75x km by train and x/2 km by car. If the speed of the car is 40 km/h and total time taken by him is 4(1)/(2) hours, then the total distance travelled by him in three modes is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speeds → Car: 40 km/h | Train: 40 × 3 = 120 km/h | Steamer: 120 ÷ 1.5 = 80 km/h

Time = Distance ÷ Speed ⇒ x/80 + 3.75x/120 + 0.5x/40 = 4.5

⇒ x(1/80 + 1/32 + 1/80) = 4.5

⇒ 9x/160 = 4.5 ⇒ x = 80

Total Distance = x + 3.75x + 0.5x = 5.25x = 5.25 × 80 = 420 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 420 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of car = 40 km/h

Total time taken = 4.5 hours

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9c565d1a85f3c02e122f958017659b009f4a86b3b2cb0148dddade7902ad9fa.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed of train = 3 × 40 = 120 km/h

⇒ Speed of steamer = 120 ÷ 1.5 = 80 km/h

⇒ Time taken by steamer = x ÷ 80 hours

⇒ Time taken by train = 3.75x ÷ 120 = x ÷ 32 hours

⇒ Time taken by car = (x/2) ÷ 40 = x ÷ 80 hours

⇒ Total time = x/80 + x/32 + x/80 = 4.5

⇒ 2x/80 + x/32 = 4.5

⇒ x/40 + x/32 = 4.5

⇒ (4x + 5x) ÷ 160 = 4.5

⇒ 9x ÷ 160 = 4.5

⇒ x = (4.5 × 160) ÷ 9 = 80

⇒ Total Distance = x + 3.75x + 0.5x = 5.25x

⇒ Total Distance = 5.25 × 80 = 420 km

**∴ The correct answer is 420 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

When an object covers multiple distances at different speeds, Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Relative Speed

If two bodies move in the same direction, relative speed is |S₁ − S₂|. If they move in opposite directions, relative speed is S₁ + S₂.

Unit Conversion

To convert a speed from km/h to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18. To convert m/s back to km/h, multiply the value by 18/5.

questions.question: 1000 solid spherical balls each of radius 0.6 cm are melted and recast into a single spherical ball. What is the surface area (in cm²) of ball so formed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

1000 solid spherical balls each of radius = 0.6 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = 4/3 × π × r³

Surface area of sphere = 4πr²

where r → radius of a sphere

**Calculation:**

Let radius of smaller ball, r = 0.6cm

Volume of 1000 smaller ball

⇒ 1000 × (4/3) × π × (0.6)³

Let radius of bigger ball be R

According to the question

(4/3) × π × R³ = 1000 × (4/3) × π × (0.6)3

⇒ R³ = 1000 × (0.6)³

⇒ R = 10 × 0.6

⇒ R = 6 cm

Now, Total surface area of bigger ball

⇒ 4 × π × (6)² = 144π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 144π cm2**

Average of 100 numbers = 48

Let each number be 48

Condition first

75% of the number increased by 4 each then

Sum of first 75 number = (48 + 4) × 75 = 52 × 75 = 3900

Second condition

25% of the number decreased by 6 each, then

Sum of last 25 numbers = (48 – 6) × 25 = 42 × 25 = 1050

Sum of 100 numbers = 3900 = 1050 = 4950

∴ Average of 100 numbers = 4950/100 = 49.5

**Short Trick:**

Let total number be 100

Then, new average of 100 numbers = 48 = [(75 × 4 – 25 × 6)/100]

⇒ 48 = [(300 – 150)/100]

⇒ 48 = 1.5

⇒ 49.5

120 dozen = 120 × 12 = 1440 oranges

questions.question: 'At constant temperature, the solubility of a gas in a liquid is proportional to the partial pressure of the gas collected above the surface of the liquid or solution'. What is this rule?
questions.solution:
Option** 1 **is correct, i.e. __**Henry's law**__.

__
 
• **Henry’s law**__, states that the weight of a gas dissolved by a liquid is proportional to the pressure of the gas upon the liquid.
 
• The law, which was first formulated in **1803** by the English physician and chemist **William Henry**, holds only for dilute solutions and low gas pressures.

**Extra facts:**

 
• **Charles' law:** A law stating that the volume of an ideal gas at constant pressure is directly proportional to the absolute temperature.
 
• **Boyle's law:** A law stating that the pressure of a given mass of an ideal gas is inversely proportional to its volume at a constant temperature.
 
• Newton's law:
 
 
• **Newton’s first law:** states that, if a body is at rest or moving at a constant speed in a straight line, it will remain at rest or keep moving in a straight line at constant speed unless it is acted upon by a force.
 
• **Newton’s second law**: States that the time rate of change of the momentum of a body is equal in both magnitude and direction to the force imposed on it.
 
• **Newton’s third law:** states that when two bodies interact, they apply forces to one another that are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction.

questions.question: Which among the following famous places is called the "Palace of Windows"?
questions.solution:
